I reported Diana’s body in Security. My route was Storage -> Medbay -> Electrical -> Security. When I got to Security, Diana was dead there.

Earlier I saw Eve and Frank in Medbay: Eve came into Medbay from Cafeteria around tick 3, and Frank was also in Medbay around ticks 3-5. I didn’t see anyone else near Security before the report. Please share routes, especially anyone who was in Electrical/Security/Navigation area.

I started cafeteria, went to oxygen, then upper engine, then lower engine. I saw Frank enter upper engine from medbay around tick 7, stayed/was around upper engine ticks 9-10, then he came down into lower engine from upper engine at tick 12 with me there.

So I can place Frank on the left side for the later part of the round, not near Security then. I didn’t see Diana at all, and I didn’t see Eve/Charlie/Bob this round. Charlie’s report location makes me want to hear from whoever was in Electrical/Security/Navigation, especially Eve since Charlie saw her in Medbay earlier and that’s close to Electrical/Security route.

I'll be straight with you all. My route was weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria. Yes, I was in Medbay around tick 4 — Charlie and Frank were both there with me, so Charlie's sighting checks out.

Here's the important part: I DID pass through Security around tick 7, and Diana was alive there when I saw her. I left toward weapons after. So whoever came into Security after me is the killer.

Also, at tick 1 I saw Bob in weapons, and he came in from Security. So Bob was in the Security area early in the round. That's worth noting.

Alice places Frank on the left side (upper/lower engine) for the later ticks, so if that's true Frank's cleared for the kill. That leaves Bob or Charlie as most suspicious to me — Charlie conveniently "found" the body, and Bob was over by Security early. I want to hear Bob's full route before I commit my vote.

I started in Security, went Weapons, then back through Security and ended in Navigation. The key thing: I saw Diana enter Security from Navigation at tick 6, alive.

Eve saying she saw me early near Weapons/Security is true, but that was early, before Diana even came into Security from Navigation, so I don’t think that makes me suspicious for the kill timing.

I did not see Eve in Security, but if Eve is saying she passed through Security around tick 7 and Diana was alive, then the kill is after that. That points more toward whoever came through after: Charlie from Electrical into Security, or possibly Eve herself if she stayed/looped. I’m not hard accusing Charlie because he reported, but the suspicious pool to me is Eve/Charlie, not Frank if Alice’s left-side info is true. I want to hear Frank before deciding.

I can confirm the early Medbay stuff: my route was Electrical -> Medbay -> Upper Engine -> Lower Engine. I saw Charlie in Medbay ticks 3-5, and Eve in Medbay ticks 3-4. Eve did come in from Cafeteria and Charlie came in from Storage, so that part lines up.

After that I went left side. I saw Alice in Upper Engine around ticks 8-9, then she went down to Lower Engine and I saw her again there at tick 12. So Alice can vouch I was nowhere near Security late, and I can vouch Alice was left side late too.

For the kill, I agree it’s between Eve/Bob/Charlie. The big issue is Eve says Diana was alive in Security around tick 7, but Bob says he didn’t see Eve there while he was moving through Security/Nav area. That feels like a contradiction. Charlie did report, but his route from Medbay -> Electrical -> Security is also exactly the body route, so I can’t fully clear him either.

If we vote, I’m leaning based on the Eve/Bob mismatch, probably Bob or Eve. I think Bob’s “ended in Navigation” after seeing Diana enter Security gives him opportunity, but Eve’s loop through Security and then away also does. I’m not confident enough to hard call it, but I would not vote Alice or Frank here.

I’ll add to my report: I found Diana dead in Security right as I entered from Electrical, and I reported immediately. My only sightings before that were Eve and Frank in Medbay, with Eve entering from Cafeteria around tick 3 and Frank there through about tick 5. I did not see Bob at all, and I did not see Diana alive.

Alice and Frank seem paired left side late, so I agree they’re probably not it. From my perspective the real pool is Eve/Bob, because I know I didn’t kill.

Between them, Bob worries me more: he says Diana entered Security from Navigation at tick 6, and then he ended in Navigation, meaning he was right next to the body location around the likely kill window. Eve’s Security sighting at tick 7 is important, but it’s also self-reported. The contradiction is Bob not seeing Eve if both were around Security/Nav/Weapons then.

I’m leaning Bob over Eve right now, but I’d like people to think about whether Bob’s route gives him the cleanest opportunity.

I can restate my hard info: I was left side the whole round — cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine. I saw Frank come from Medbay into Upper Engine around tick 7, then he was with/near me upper engine ticks 9-10 and came down to Lower Engine at tick 12. So I’m comfortable clearing Frank for this kill, and he can clear me from being near Security.

For the body, I agree the pool is Eve/Bob/Charlie. Charlie reporting doesn’t fully clear him, but his story matches the Medbay sightings. The main conflict is around Security: Bob says Diana entered Security from Navigation at tick 6, Eve says Diana was alive in Security around tick 7, and Bob says he didn’t see Eve.

I don’t think Bob not seeing Eve is automatically impossible if he had already moved into Navigation, but Bob was definitely closest to Security/Nav during the likely window. Eve also had a route through Security and could have killed or lied about Diana being alive. I’m leaning Bob slightly more than Eve right now because he admits being right next to Security when Diana arrived, but I’m not 100% certain. Charlie is third in the pool for me.

Alright, I've already given my route and observations. Let me push on what matters now.

The vote is shaping up as Eve vs Bob. Here's why I think it's Bob:

1. Bob admits he was bouncing between Security, Weapons, and Navigation the entire round. That's the exact corridor where Diana died. He had constant opportunity.

2. Bob says he "saw Diana enter Security from Navigation at tick 6" — convenient detail that puts Diana in Security but doesn't put HIM there at the kill moment. But by his own admission he ended in Navigation, which is one room away.

3. Bob claims he didn't see me in Security at tick 7. That's possible if he'd already moved to Navigation by then — but it also could be a lie to make my story look shaky. I'm telling you Diana was alive when I left Security and went to Weapons. After that the only person who logically loops back through is someone who was already in the Security/Nav cluster — that's Bob.

4. Frank and Alice clearly vouch for each other on the left side. Charlie's Medbay sighting of me and Frank checks out with Frank's own account, so Charlie's early route is consistent.

The cleanest opportunity is Bob. I'm voting Bob. If I'm wrong, it's Charlie — but I trust the reporter slightly more than the guy who was parked next to the body location.

I need to push back here because “Bob was near the area” is true, but the timing being used against me is off.

My route was Security -> Weapons -> back through Security -> Navigation. At tick 6, I saw Diana enter Security from Navigation alive. After that, I moved into Navigation and stayed there. That’s exactly why I didn’t see Eve in Security at tick 7 — I was no longer in Security, I was in/going into Navigation. So that “contradiction” isn’t really a contradiction.

Eve is the one saying she was actually in Security with Diana alive at tick 7, then left toward Weapons. That means Eve is self-reporting being alone in the body room after I left. If Diana died after tick 7, Eve had direct opportunity, and her “Diana was alive when I left” is not confirmed by anyone.

Charlie also has opportunity coming from Electrical into Security, but he reported immediately and his earlier Medbay timing is backed by Frank. I don’t fully clear Charlie, but between Charlie and Eve, Eve’s story feels more like she’s trying to pin it on me because I was nearby.

Alice and Frank are clear to me for this kill. My vote is almost certainly Eve here.

I think we have to make a call between Bob and Eve here, not Alice/Frank and probably not first on Charlie.

My hard info hasn’t changed: Alice and I were left side late, so we’re not in the Security kill window. Charlie’s early Medbay route matches what I saw, and he did report, though I agree that doesn’t hard-clear him.

The deciding point for me is this: Bob’s “I didn’t see Eve” explanation actually makes sense if he had already gone into Navigation. So that contradiction is weaker than I first thought. Eve is the one who admits being in Security with Diana alive around tick 7, and that alive timing is only backed by Eve herself. If Eve killed after that, then saying “Diana was alive when I left” is exactly the kind of cover story a Duck would use.

Bob was nearby, yes, but Eve was directly in the body room during the likely window by her own story. I’m leaning Eve over Bob now. If Eve flips good, then I’d look at Charlie/Bob next, but for this vote I think Eve is the strongest.
